messages:
Alex Chen: Ran a perfetto capture for ~2m on staging (client->gateway->runtime). Seeing ~150ms tail spikes at 99th. Correlates to a gap between gateway span end and runtime kernel dispatch. Trace: https://perfetto.dev/trace/abcd1234 :eyes:

Maria Gomez: Can you paste the kernel timeline zoom? Any kernel-selection thrashing or fallback kernels?

Alex Chen: zoom snippet:
```
0.000s client_send
0.012s gateway_recv
0.035s gateway_dispatch
0.150s runtime_kernel_select
0.300s runtime_token_generation
```
Looks like dispatch -> kernel_select is ~115ms in bad cases. NVTX markers show delayed KV cache lookup.

Samir Patel: Did you check batching heuristics? Maybe gateway is waiting to form a batch and holds the request before dispatch.

Alex Chen: instrumented batching: gateway emits batch_start at 0.035 but batch_size==1 frequently. There's a ~100ms wait for an ephemeral KV lookup to return. Hypothesis: async KV miss path falls back to a sync path that blocks dispatch.

PerfettoBot: [automated] Trace ingest completed for trace abcd1234, nsys profile id nsys-9987 attached.

Ingrid L.: Can you share the nsys kernel timeline? Look for cuLaunchKernel delays and cudaEvent waits that would indicate host-side stalls.

Alex Chen: pasted nsys hotspot: main kernels are queued but cuLaunch latency spikes align with a cudaMemcpyAsync triggered by KV miss handler. nvprof shows a memcpy stall of ~110ms.

Dave R.: Suggestion: change KV miss fallback to async prefetch + early return to gateway so dispatch doesn't block. Also add a short max-wait on gateway (10ms) before shipping to runtime with a forced miss token.

Maria Gomez: Also add telemetry: histogram of dispatch->kernel_select latency and an alert for buckets >50ms. Add a perf test that simulates high KV miss rates.

Alex Chen: I'll push a prototype branch (w/ telemetry) and schedule another perfetto run. Thanks all :thumbsup:
